evidence.quote: With current inflation low and stable, interest rates are substantially lower than in the 1980s, and overall leverage has been less pronounced.
Farm incomes are expected to remain relatively low this year after declining sharply from the 2013 peak.
higher tariffs on soybeans and other U.S. exports and continued uncertainty over trade policy represent headwinds for American producers.
The outlook for U.S. agriculture is challenging, though agricultural banks remain relatively stable.
